mapper.select: SELECT fuel_date AS fuelDate, fuel_test_bill_no AS fuelTestBillNo, fuel_name AS fuelName, fuel_temp AS fuelTemp, fuel_dnst AS fuelDnst FROM T_FUEL WHERE fuel_airport_code = #{staffAirportCode} and fuel_logic_del_flg = 0 and fuel_date < now() ORDER BY fuel_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT fuel_date AS fuelDate, fuel_test_bill_no AS fuelTestBillNo, fuel_temp AS fuelTemp, fuel_dnst AS fuelDnst FROM T_FUEL WHERE fuel_date IN (SELECT MAX(fuel_date) FROM T_FUEL) AND fuel_airport_code = #{staffAirportCode}

select staff_id AS staffId, staff_pwd AS staffPwd, staff_name AS staffName, staff_age AS staffAge, staff_gender AS staffGender, staff_type AS staffType, staff_phone AS staffPhone, staff_company AS staffCompany, staff_serv_station AS staffServStation, staff_airport_code AS staffAirportCode, staff_aptarea_code AS staffAptareaCode, staff_group_id AS staffGroupId from T_STAFF where staff_id = #{taskOpeStaffId}

select fuel_test_bill_no as fuelTestBillNo, fuel_date as fuelDate, fuel_name as fuelName, fuel_temp as fuelTemp, fuel_dnst as fuelDnst, fuel_airport_code as fuelAirportCode from T_FUEL where fuel_test_bill_no = #{fuelTestBillNo} and fuel_date = NOW() and fuel_logic_del_flg = 0
